newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean Samick defaults on notes.
newsitem.headline: South Korean Samick defaults on notes.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange on Thursday again suspended trading in shares of South Korea's leading piano manufacturer Samick Musical Instruments Co Ltd, confirming that it has defaulted on payments of 2.7 billion won worth of promissory notes.
The exchange said trading in the shares, which was halted on Wednesday due to the default talk, would resume on Friday but the company would be placed on a watch list.
Samick's shares last traded at 6,140 won.
